newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Eltech expects better business in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Eltech expects better business in 1997.

text.p: Eltech Electronics Ltd said on Friday it expected its contract manufacturing business to improve in 1997 compared to 1996.
The group said in a statement accompanying its 1996 results that it had completed its corporate restructuring and was now in a better position to benefit from it.
It said it has diversified into real estate to broaden its earnings base.
In 1996, Eltech recorded a net profit of Singapore S$46,000 compared to a loss of S$10.94 million in 1995.

The company had won bids for various plots of land in Singapore designated for residential development. Eltech will form a wholly-owned subsidiary or subdiiaries to handle these developments which it intends to finance through internal resources and bank borrowings, the statement said.
Eltech would seek shareholders approval to embark on these projects, it said.
